description_en: Replicates databases between RDS SQL Server instances
description_zh: 该接口用于在RDS SQL Server实例间复制数据库
kebab_example: aliyun rds copy-database-between-instances --db-instance-id rm-bp172446ys9cf0000 --target-db-instance-id rm-bp1m71wvzfiq70000 --db-names zhttest_:_zhttest --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyDatabaseBetweenInstances

parameters.help_en: The source instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The destination instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: target_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The names of the databases that you want to copy. Format: `Source database name 1,Source database name 2`
parameters.help_zh:
待复制的数据库名称列表，格式如下：`{"源实例的数据库名称":"目标实例的数据库名称"}`。复制多个库时，用英文逗号（,）分隔。示例如下：

复制单个库：`{"zhttest":"zhttest"}`
复制多个库：`{"zhttest01":"zhttest01","zhttest02":"zhttest02"}`

目标实例的数据库名称可与源实例不同，但复制前需确保目标实例中不存在同名数据库
parameters.name: db_names

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set based on which you want to restore databases of the source instance. When you replicate databases by backup set, you can call the DescribeBackups operation to obtain the ID of the backup set.

You must specify one of the BackupId and RestoreTime parameters
parameters.help_zh:
源实例备份集ID。按备份集复制数据库时，可以通过查询备份列表接口DescribeBackups获取备份集ID。
调用接口时，BackupId和RestoreTime需传入任意一个
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en:
The point in time when the system replicates databases. You can select a point in time within the backup retention period. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

You must specify one of the BackupId and RestoreTime parameters
parameters.help_zh: 按时间点复制数据库，可以选择备份保留周期内的任意时间点。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 调用接口时，BackupId和RestoreTime需传入任意一个
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to copy users and permissions.

YES: copies users and permissions. If the destination instance has a user whose name is the same as a user in the source instance, the permissions of the user in the source instance will also be granted to the user in the destination instance after you copy user permissions.
NO: does not copy users and permissions.

Default value: NO
parameters.help_zh:
是否复制用户和权限，取值：
YES：表示复制用户和权限。如果目标实例中有同名的用户，则该用户将叠加源实例的同名用户的权限。
NO（默认值）：表示不复制用户和权限
parameters.name: sync_user_privilege
